name: Chili-Rubbed Halibut with Black Beans, Peppers & Cilantro-Lime Crema

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, mix together the spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Pat the fish dry with paper towels and place on a plate; drizzle with olive oil and rub both sides with the spice mixture. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg halibut fillet
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 green bell peppers
3 limes
3 jalapeño peppers
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Peel and slice onions into half rings. Slice bell peppers into strips.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add garlic, onion, bell peppers, and beans to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender, 8-10 minutes. Cover and remove from heat; set aside.
Meanwhile, juice limes into a blender.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of each jalapeño with a spoon. Roughly chop and add to blender. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and add leaves to the blender.
Add yogurt, salt, and garlic powder to blender. Purée until smooth, about 30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet to medium-high heat. Add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place the fish on the skillet; cook until it is opaque in the center, 3-4 minutes per side. Work in batches if necessary.
To serve, divide the vegetables and fish between plates. Drizzle with the cilantro-lime crema. Enjoy!
